Package threepl.exec

Class QueueRefs.SetPair

java.lang.Object
threepl.exec.QueueRefs.SetPair
Enclosing class:
QueueRefs
public class QueueRefs.SetPair extends Object
This class holds a pair of sets representing an availability expression. The set in field queues is a set of queue variables. The set in field sigs is a set of TDEVar conditional signals. The class represents the logical product of the elements in both sets. Instances of this set are stored in another set, field read_ands in class QueueRefs, which represents products to be ORed.
